CUHK (SZ)
                                Course Outline

1. Course Identity

A. Course as listed in CUHK (SZ)

The information in this block should be exactly as approved by CUHK Senate. In case there are
any differences, please explain in the table below.

Course code         ECO3121
Course title (English)    Introductory Econometrics
Course title (Chinese) 计量经济学导论
Units                3
Description (English)   This course provides an introduction to econometric theory and practice.
              We begin with a comprehensive discussion of simple and multiple
                        regression analysis. More advanced topics will be tackled later in the
                        semester, such as time series analysis, panel data, and binary models.
                   The purpose of the course is to introduce you the statistical methods that
                      economists use to test economic theory and interpret economic data, and
                          to give you experience in estimating econometric models with real
                     world data.

                       This course has a strong applied emphasis. We will use STATA for data
                          analysis. The course will provide you the opportunity to establish your
                            skills of applying STATA in empirical study. Instructions on how to use
                         the software will be given in tutorials and, if necessary, some of the
                           tutorials may take place in the computer lab.

Description (Chinese) 本课程介绍了计量经济学的理论基础与实践。包括应用统计方法
          （主要通过回归分析）进行经济数据实证分析进而得出结论。本课
          的目的是为学生介绍计量经济学理论基础和相关实践，以及让学生
          学会如何使用真实数据进行计量经济模型分析。

           本课程具备很强的应用性，我们将使用STATA 进行数据分析。本
           课程将培养学生在实证研究中运用STATA 的技能。该软件的使用
          将在辅导课程中说明，一些习题课可能会安排在计算机实验室里进
          行。


B. Corresponding course in CUHK

Please give details of the closest corresponding course in CUHK (as approved by CUHK Senate
and listed in course list).  If the course in SZ maps to more than one course in CUHK, please
make multiple copies of the block below.

Course code       ECON 3121
Course title (English)    Introductory Econometrics
Course title (Chinese) 计量经济学导论
Units                3
Description (English)   This course studies the basic econometric theory and the application of
                      econometric methods to actual economic  data. The emphasis  is on
                        explaining basic ideas behind formulas and rules. Topics covered are:
                        basic concepts of statistical inference; estimation and inference for the
                        general linear statistical model; stochastic regressors; heteroscedasticity;
                        disturbance  related  sets  of regression  equations;  multicollinearity;
                         autocorrelation;  and  specification,  identification  and  estimation  of
                       simultaneous equation models. Students are advised to take ECON2121
                        before taking this course.
Description (Chinese) 本科探讨基本计量经济理论及计量方法在经济资料分析上之应用，
          强调利用公式及数学/统计学上的法则来解说其基本概念。内容包
          括：统计理论的基本概念；一般线性统计模型的估计与推论；随机
          回归自变数；非均齐变异数；干扰项相关的回归方程组；线性重
          合；自行相关；面板数据分析；以及联立方程模型的认定。学生修
            读本科前宜先修读ECON2121 。


2.  Prerequisites / Co-requisites

A. Prerequisites

ECO2121 Basic Statistics or other equivalent classes

B. Co-requisites

No co-requisites


3. Learning Outcomes

By the end of this course, our student should be able to:
1)  Critically read the quantitative analysis performed by other researchers.
2) Formulate their own econometric models to perform empirical investigations in business
   economics and finance
3)  Collect and organize economic and financial data, and use statistical software packages
   (STATA/R/Python) for empirical analysis

5.  Assessment Scheme

There will be four homework assignments, a midterm, and a comprehensive final. More details
for the assignments/exams will be discussed in class. The homework assignments’ due dates will
be specified when they are assigned. You have to turn in your homework at the beginning of the
class and no late homework assignments are accepted. The worst assignment will be dropped
and only the 3 highest assignments will be counted on the assessment.

The composition of your final grade will look like this:

Component/ method                     % weight
Assignments (3 highest of 4 to be counted on)                     25%
Midterm                                              30%
Final Exam                                            45%


6. Reading

A. Required

Introductory Econometrics: A Modern Approach, Wooldridge, Jeffrey M., Cengage Learning, 6th
edition, 2015.

B. Recommended

Introduction to Econometrics, Stock and Watson, Pearson Education, 3rd edition, 2011.

10. Any other information

STATA/Python/R:
Students are encouraged to use the statistical software STATA/Python/R.
No prior knowledge of STATA/Python/R is assumed. Your TA will help you use this software
package during the tutorial hours.

ASTATA introduction file can be found at[link] which is quite helpful
for you to get a general idea of STATA.
